flashcard_questions.q: Which line opens the White Shoppers scene in Rise Up?
Where did the Little White Girl sit in the White Shoppers scene?
flashcard_questions.a: On a tall stool centre stage, as the focal point.

flashcard_questions.q: Why did the White shoppers speak in a high pitch?
flashcard_questions.a: To suggest they were “air heads” who did not think for themselves.

flashcard_questions.q: Which word did the Little White Girl’s mum elongate for emphasis?
How did the Little White Girl say “why?” to her mother?
flashcard_questions.a: With a rising pitch at the end of the word.

flashcard_questions.q: What does the mum’s reply “just different honey” reveal?
flashcard_questions.a: She has no real justification and little education on the subject.

flashcard_questions.q: How did the White shoppers show they thought as one?
flashcard_questions.a: They linked arms in very close proximity and spoke in unison.

flashcard_questions.q: Which costume item did Em and Dayz add to play the White shoppers?
flashcard_questions.a: A single white glove each, worn on opposite hands.

flashcard_questions.q: How did lighting mark the Little White Girl’s introduction?
flashcard_questions.a: The white wash increased in intensity and the blue was removed.

flashcard_questions.q: Why did Uncle George stand across a tall and a small stool?
flashcard_questions.a: To widen his gait and look larger and more intimidating.

flashcard_questions.q: What did Uncle George’s position on the highest level signify?
flashcard_questions.a: His power as ringleader of the White mob.

flashcard_questions.q: How did Em’s Freedom Rider react during the bus attack?
flashcard_questions.a: She stayed static and composed, reciting the Lord’s Prayer.

flashcard_questions.q: How did Dayz’s Freedom Rider show fear on the bus?
flashcard_questions.a: Quick-paced breaths and exaggerated, fidgety shoulder movements.

flashcard_questions.q: Why did the actors raise their arms in slow motion during the explosion?
flashcard_questions.a: It marked the moment and showed their protest stayed non-violent.

flashcard_questions.q: What built the climax of the bus explosion scene?
flashcard_questions.a: A sound collage of layered voices.

notes: 15 cards: 5 voice-technique cards tied to named lines, 5 physicality and staging, 2 lighting and sound, 2 causal, 1 costume detail. Quotations are verbatim from the lesson, except that the two lines carrying racial slurs were described rather than quoted. The shop name was dropped as flavour.
